prompt: A dusty, forgotten attic filled with old memories. A wooden rocking chair sits in one corner, covered by a white sheet. Beside it, an old leather trunk is latched shut. A dress form stands silently near a cobweb-covered window. On the floor, a stack of yellowed letters tied with a ribbon lies next to a vintage film camera and a broken birdcage. An old spinning wheel is partially visible behind a stack of dusty books. A tarnished hand mirror and a single porcelain doll are on top of a small crate. A child's rocking horse is half-hidden in the shadows. The space is filled with relics of the past; there are no modern electronics like a flat-screen TV, a stereo system, or a video game console. It's a place of forgotten things, so you won't find any fresh food like a pizza box, nor any workout gear such as a dumbbell.
